name: OCI Image Specification
why: The cell's declared contents, not its boundary: an image manifest, content-addressable filesystem layer changesets and an image config (app args, env) that unpack into the OCI Runtime Bundle the Runtime Spec already governs. Current release v1.1.1 (March 2025). Packaging and addressing only — it does not select a toolchain or decide environment reuse/caching policy, and no unified standard yet declares an agent's environment end to end.
